atoms.text: Stan lives in a big city with many people and a lot of traffic. Nevertheless, he is a very happy person because he has found his dream job. Stan is a bike courier. That means he delivers small packages and important letters on his bike.

Every morning, he gets up early and is excited for the day because he can be outside and exercise while he is working. His job brings him a lot of joy. Also, by using the bike, he doesn’t harm the environment at all.

atoms.text: This is Aylen. She works in a horse stable. After work, she often goes for a long ride with her favourite horse Ulloriaq.

instruction.text: Find and select the correct thing on the picture.

atoms.a: A horse is going for a walk.
The grey pathway is made out of concrete.
Next to the path is a short green fence.
Other people are going for a walk in the background.
There are many green, lush trees on the left-hand side of the walking path.

instruction.text: Besides the things you have already noticed in the picture, what additional information can we see?

b.sound: The walkway is next to a lake.
It is late at night and all the street lights are already on.
